entities.name: RemoteUEInformationSidelink procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE to inform about required SIB(s) and provide paging related information to the connected L2 U2N Relay UE.

entities.name: RemoteUEInformationSidelink message
entities.description: Message sent from Remote UE to Relay UE containing required SIB information and paging related information.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where the Remote UE can initiate the RemoteUEInformationSidelink procedure.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: RRC state where the Remote UE can initiate the RemoteUEInformationSidelink procedure.

entities.name: Required SIBs information
entities.description: Information about the required System Information Blocks that the Remote UE needs.

entities.name: Paging related information
entities.description: Paging related information provided by the Remote UE to the Relay UE.

relations.description: The procedure involves sending the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message.
The procedure can be initiated when the Remote UE is in RRC_IDLE state.
The procedure can be initiated when the Remote UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state.
The message contains information about required SIBs.
The message contains paging related information.
